template_data.headline_html: Five things most people never check in SAM.

items.title: Registration expiration
items.sub: Renew 60 days out — not the week it lapses

items.title: NAICS code accuracy
items.sub: Stale codes hide you from the buyers who need you

items.title: Legal business name
items.sub: Must match IRS filing exactly — every character

items.title: Points of contact
items.sub: Dead emails on your profile = failed bid waiting

items.title: CAGE code linkage
items.sub: Ownership changes must be reflected here
